resources.string: Pump integration for Ypsomed YpsoPump (plaintext research pump)

This DELIVERS up to 1.1 U: a 0.1 U standard bolus as a control, then 1.0 U as an extended bolus at the first duration the pump accepts (1, 15, 30 or 60 min). Rejected attempts deliver nothing. The extended bolus is cancelled after 30 seconds.
SALINE ONLY, OFF-BODY, CANNULA TO AIR.
It writes no treatment record; the history sync will pick up whatever the pump logs. Do not run this with insulin in the cartridge.
Probe running — this takes about two minutes. Watch the log.
SALINE TEST BUILD — bolus, temp basal and basal profile write are enabled and verified on saline. Not for use with insulin.
Scan for your pump and bond to it. Confirm the code shown on the pump.
No YpsoPump found. Wake the pump and keep it close.
Bonding failed. Wake the pump and try again.

Check the serial matches the pump you intend AAPS to use. Do not select a pump that another app is using to deliver insulin.
Confirm the pairing request, and check the code matches the one shown on the pump.

This writes the phone\'s date and time to the pump.\n\nThe pump\'s clock is read back afterwards, and the result below reflects what the pump actually reports — not whether the write was accepted. The driver also does this by itself after a timezone change, or if the pump\'s clock drifts.
Pump clock set, and confirmed by reading it back from the pump.
Pump clock NOT confirmed. Check the clock on the pump itself and read the log before trying again.
Pump not connected — no bolus was sent
Bolus failed — the pump did not confirm any delivery
Temp basal failed — the pump did not confirm it
Temp basal cancel failed — the pump did not confirm it
Pump basal rate not read yet — cannot convert U/h to a percentage
Basal profile NOT confirmed — check the 24 rates on the pump before relying on it
YpsoPump is not delivering insulin (%1$s). Basal has stopped.
The YpsoPump\'s clock is %1$d seconds out and could not be corrected. Events the pump logs will carry the wrong time. Set it from the YPSO tab.
The YpsoPump\'s clock is %1$d hours from the phone\'s. That is too far to correct automatically — check the time on both the pump and the phone.
The phone\'s time changed but the YpsoPump\'s clock could not be corrected. The pump\'s clock is now wrong, and events it logs will carry the wrong time. Set it from the YPSO tab.
Bolus of %1$.2f U exceeds the pump maximum of %2$.2f U

The pump has no speed setting. Slower speeds are produced by the phone, which splits a large bolus into several small ones a few seconds apart — more comfortable, and each small bolus still goes in at the pump\'s full rate. AAPS cannot reach the pump until the whole sequence has finished.
Pump is configured for tiny bolus steps
Pumps weaker than this are hidden when pairing
How many recent entries to pull from each pump log

Brings boluses and temp basals given on the pump itself into AAPS. Without it, a bolus from the pump\'s own menu is invisible and AAPS may dose on top of it. The first sync after enabling imports nothing — it records where to start.
Try this if the pump accepts the auth write but then refuses to answer reads
